recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-26901 unless a future Pharmacy decision changes MedicationDispense.subject cardinality.
issue_request: FHIR-26901 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request raised against R4 asking to make MedicationDispense.subject mandatory because MedicationDispense was the only medication-related event resource with subject at 0..1. The approved resolution was to make MedicationDispense.subject 1..1 for R5.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation in git commit 603de50396973db754fec17786a66ce29799296c, whose message included FHIR-26901 and whose patch changed the then-authoritative MedicationDispense spreadsheet cardinality for MedicationDispense.subject from 0..1 to 1..1. The later source rework in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried that 1..1 cardinality into source/medicationdispense/structuredefinition-MedicationDispense.xml.
additional_context: MedicationDispense is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current combined branch already has MedicationDispense.subject with min=1 and max=1 in the StructureDefinition. Parallel medication resources such as MedicationRequest, MedicationAdministration, and MedicationStatement also have mandatory subject elements, matching the issue rationale. Pharmacy Confluence meeting notes from 2020-04-27 and 2020-05-04 reference FHIR-26901 as a Pharmacy tracker item, and targeted Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: This reconciliation made no source change. The current authoritative MedicationDispense StructureDefinition is already correct for the Jira request, and a check of MedicationDispense XML examples found no MedicationDispense examples missing subject.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request requiring MedicationDispense.subject to be made mandatory at 1..1.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final work-group request and target cardinality for the reconciliation.

evidence_items.summary: MedicationDispense is listed as an active resource and has the mdd abbreviation in fhir.ini.
evidence_items.learned: The MedicationDispense StructureDefinition is in current core build scope.

evidence_items.summary: MedicationDispense.subject currently has min=1 and max=1.
evidence_items.learned: The current source already implements the requested 1..1 cardinality.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-26901-tagged commit changed the historical MedicationDispense spreadsheet cardinality row from 0..1 to 1..1.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was applied before the later source rework generated the current StructureDefinition source.

evidence_items.summary: Pharmacy meeting notes list FHIR-26901 as the MedicationDispense.subject mandatory tracker and point to the updated Jira issue.
evidence_items.learned: Meeting evidence is consistent with the Jira resolution and does not identify a different source action.

evidence_items.locator: Zulip searches and local example scan
evidence_items.command: bun run zulip:search fts '"FHIR-26901"' --limit 10; bun run zulip:search fts 'MedicationDispense subject mandatory' --limit 10; for f in source/medicationdispense/*.xml; do if rg -q '<MedicationDispense\b|<MedicationDispense ' "$f" && ! rg -q '<subject>|<subject ' "$f"; then echo "$f"; fi; done
evidence_items.query: FHIR-26901; MedicationDispense subject mandatory; MedicationDispense examples without subject
evidence_items.summary: No Zulip hits were found and no MedicationDispense XML examples without subject were found.
evidence_items.learned: No discovered community discussion or example inconsistency changes the no-change conclusion.
